name: app-oviah-connected-experience-onboarding-screens-fan
title: OVIAH 'Designed to work as one connected experience' with a fanned row of onboarding screens and a hand-held hero
whatItIs: A white slide with the statement heading, a row of six onboarding phone screens (splash, create account, personalise, welcome-back login) fanned in a line, and a large hand holding a phone showing the splash screen and 'Get Started' buttons at the right.
whatItMeans: Cohesive and confident; the fanned row argues that every screen shares one visual language.
techniques: Fan a sequence of screens in a single row to show consistency.
Pair a summary statement with a hand-held hero device.
Repeat the same button and card styling across all screens shown.

vocabulary.definition: Screens arranged side by side to show sequence or variety.
A product where every screen feels part of one coherent system.
